summary: Every material solver-visible obligation in instruction.md and the referenced /app/fluidlab/docs contracts maps to meaningful native publication assertions, and all 14 verifier behaviors (13 F2P / 1 P2P) are discoverable from that contract surface plus inherited runtime interfaces. Determinism, mixed liquid/gas analysis, limit surfacing, lineage, cross-artifact consistency, and entrypoint preservation are bidirectionally aligned. Residual gaps are advisory only: malformed-input rejection, WARN/non-pressure finding isolation, and analysis-contract nested-schema completeness.

evidence.observation: One short paragraph plus ten concise bullets state the repair objective, build/entrypoint preservation, three publication artifacts, determinism, input validation, liquid/gas support, coupled physics, violation surfacing, lineage, multi-dimensional rollups, and recompute-from-inputs requirement.
Binding publication schema for summary.json field order, fleet_rollup keys, case/operating-point records, CSV severity sort, and checkpoint mirroring.
Case and operating-point input schema with incompressible_liquid and ideal_gas models, SI units, and identity preservation rules.
Build/analyze entrypoints, config/cases inputs, artifact outputs, and CLI/wrapper pipeline equivalence expectation.
Publication csv_fields, severity_order, round_digits, schema_version, and output paths referenced by analysis-contract and runbook.
Inherited publisher defines nested operating_point case_id lineage, JSON indent/trailing newline, publication_revision digest, and CSV row composition discoverable as runtime interface.

14 behavioral pytest cases (13 F2P / 1 P2P) drive build, CLI/wrapper parity, schema shape, golden determinism, fleet/case statuses, compressible limit finding, CSV/checkpoint consistency, lineage cardinality, and liquid-case preservation without embedding a callable end-to-end solver.

findings.criterion: Pre-acceptance validation rejection path not individually probed.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires validating geometry, fluid, mesh, envelope, solver-monitor, and publication configuration before accepting a case; inherited loaders implement rejection, but all graded fixtures are valid so a solver could skip validation and still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional holdout malformed-case fixture asserting ConfigurationError or bounded skip behavior.

findings.criterion: WARN severity and non-pressure finding codes not isolated.
findings.why_it_matters: Solver-visible severity engine defines MACH_LIMIT, CFL_LIMIT, MESH_SCORE_LIMIT, CONVERGENCE_LIMIT, and WARN precedence, but fixtures produce one FAIL (PRESSURE_DROP_LIMIT) and zero WARN rows; other codes are covered only via golden recomputation.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional near-limit fixture probing WARN or alternate FAIL code independently of golden bytes.

findings.why_it_matters: Graded summary bytes require nested case_id on operating_points, enumerated margin keys, convergence.residuals objects, and finding metric/actual/limit fields; analysis-contract lists top-level operating_point keys but not these nested shapes—discoverable from inherited runtime, not phantom.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional doc expansion in analysis-contract.md for margins, convergence.residuals, and findings record layout.
